enforcement.pwa_client: pwa/nuxel-common/bridge.js (NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION) — a ping that does not declare this version is a version MISMATCH, never a silent mock downgrade
enforcement.http_bridge: services/nuxel-bridge/src/api.py — /api/v1/ping and /api/v1/health publish bridge_version; a request carrying a mismatching X-Nuxel-Bridge-Version is answered 409 version_mismatch (loud, never silently rejected)
enforcement.verifier: tools/s10plus/a33/verify-app-registry.py — asserts this file, bridge.js's NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION, every app manifest's nuxel.bridge_version and the installed systemd Environment= pins all agree

history.note: Current protocol contract. Additive changes keep 1; a breaking change to the /rpc envelope or the capability ids bumps it and every manifest must move with it.

note: bridge_version is the PWA<->host PROTOCOL contract declared by every app manifest. host_version is the implementation version of the nuxel-bridge processes and is allowed to move without a manifest change.
